how_to_read: Keys are repository-relative paths as they existed before 2026-11-21; values are where the same file lives now (both steps applied). Anything written between the two steps uses src/raosim/... and raosim.<package>...: apply steps[1].prefix_rules. Historical records (logbooks, review journals, result.json provenance, the MOC extension plan) keep their spelling on purpose; translate through this file instead of rewriting them.

steps.what: flat raosim/*.py modules into component packages under src/raosim/; lrekit/ -> src/lrekit/; main.py -> raosim.legacy.toolbox; scripts/ research files -> tests/experiments/; tests regrouped
canonical package renamed: everything under src/raosim/ moved to src/lrekit/ (same relative paths); raosim is now a compatibility package (only __init__.py, __main__.py) whose names alias lrekit
steps.unchanged_on_purpose: Versioned identifiers that begin with 'raosim.' (model ids such as 'raosim.rao_existence_scan:...:v2', format ids such as 'raosim.cad_units.v1', the 'raosim.chamber-property-table.v1' table format and hash salts) name data formats, not modules, and were not renamed.

module_aliases.source: src/lrekit/_compat.py FLAT_ALIASES (relative names; both raosim.<old> and lrekit.<old> resolve)

pre_move_sha256.how_to_use: SHA-256 of every moved or edited file immediately before the move (old paths). Applying the inverse of module_aliases to a moved file and comparing against this hash proves it was a pure rename; on 2026-11-21, 421 of 489 matched and the remaining 67 carry only reviewed path/import edits.
